title: Laguna Park 2
shortDescription: Laguna Park 2 is a three-storey townhouse and villa enclave by Laguna Property beside the Laguna resort complex in Choeng Thale, completed in 2023.
description: Laguna Park 2 is a three-storey townhouse and villa enclave by Laguna Property beside the Laguna resort complex in Choeng Thale, completed in 2023. Owners get Laguna resort privileges such as club membership and shuttle access.
facilities: Free shuttle bus and ferry between Laguna resorts
5 years free Laguna Phuket Golf Club membership
